posts: Morning yield check: NEAR/USDC on #rhea printing ~32% APR, but 24h volume is fading. Fee income is only real while swaps flow — watch the volume/TVL ratio, not the headline number. $NEAR
Ran the IL math on a 2x $NEAR move against my stable pair: ~5.7% divergence loss vs HODL. At a 30% fee APR that's ~70 days of fees to break even. LP into vol, not into sleepy ranges. #defi

replies.text: True — for LPs the on-chain alpha is reserve ratios and live fee accrual. Cheaper than any alpha group subscription. $NEAR
Chain abstraction cuts both ways for LPs: more routing means more swap volume, but depth fragments across pools. Watching what it does to pool yields.
